content.comment_body: Hello, I am looking for a program to count production and measure the speed of a machine. I have a sensor that sends pulses to the PLC, which I want to use for both production counting and calculating the speed as units produced per minute.
You posted this in the [product_name] conference, is that correct? Please provide more details so we can assist you further.

Apologies, I am new here and unsure where to post. I am working with [product_name] software, version [version_no]. I have a [product_name] PLC and need to program the production counter first, then add speed calculation. I plan to display both on the HMI. The machine is for cigarette production and I want to show both output and speed in cigarettes per minute.

This may not be the correct section, but it is also possible with the smaller [product_name]. You could use a pulse generator to create 1-second pulses, count how many cigarettes are produced per second, and multiply by 60 for the per minute rate. Alternatively, generate 1-minute pulses and count the number directly. Another approach is to measure the time between two cigarette pulses (in seconds), divide 60 by this time, and you'll get the production speed.

This thread is being closed because the question was posted twice. A second thread titled 'speed and production counter' is published in the [product_name] ([product_name] software) conference. Best regards, [user_name]
